name: Migrate Source YAML Fileset
description: A migrate source plugin for reading from a set of YAML files.
project_description:
Allows a set of YAML files to be used as a source for migrations. Each file represents a row for migration.

 In my_migrate_module/migrations/pages.yml: 

 

id: pages

source:

 plugin: yaml_fileset

 path: 'modules/custom/my_migrate_module/content/pages'

 ids:

 id:

 type: string

process:

 title: title

 body/value: body

 body/format:

 plugin: default_value

 default_value: plain_text

 source: body_format

destination:

 plugin: 'entity:node'

 default_bundle: page
